validator: independent GLB and Blender surface audit

method.intersection_test: Blender triangle BVHTree plus coplanar plane-bin / 2D separating-axis test, excluding shared geometric vertex pairs
method.intermediate_sampling: Body morph weights .25/.5/.75; local bone quaternion slerps from rest to each named pose at .25/.5/.75, with linear local translation, scale, and morph weights.
method.limitations: Discrete endpoint and intermediate samples; no continuous collision detection; incident triangle overlaps are excluded; visual deformation and reference likeness require rendered review.
